mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-employment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate signals an imminent labor market slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate hiring and wage growth decelerate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening economy, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced corporate activity and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the past 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening housing market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as the demand shock propagates through the economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 450000.0 and HOUST declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
